message: かみりゅ
The breeze blowing down from the autumn-tinted blue sky feels refreshing.
Thanks to the cooperation of all the students and the people living in Ryuusei Town, KiraFes ended in huge success.
Still, a part of me feels a bit uneasy. Did Azel truly enjoy herself from the bottom of her heart?

name: Paqy
message: 「Just leave her be. Aze-ko hates noisy crowds, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's exactly why I'm looking for her. I want to hear her thoughts on the Holy Night Festival. You know? Christmas has a quiet vibe to it, doesn't it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, well, she wasn't at the church or the overlook, and she ain't at any of the other deserted spots either.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bet she's holed up in the girls' dorm. Just give it up already.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not like you, Paqy. You're always pushing me forward, so why are you saying things like that?」

name: Paqy
message: 「H-How should I know!」
Puzzled by Paqy's attitude, I head toward Asukai Shrine. The odds of running into Azel there are probably low, but it's another quiet, peaceful place.

name: Synn
message: 「There you are!!」

name: Azel
message: 「He is here!?」

name: Azel
message: 「This place is magnificent. Just like the church, it overflows with a wise and deeply affectionate presence.」

name: Azel
message: 「Yet I cannot see the Lord's form. Is this merely an afterglow, or is He truly here as you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm... All I can tell is that you're here, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「...A foolish question.」

name: Synn
message: 「The neighborhood kids are playing in the shrine grounds... I-Is it too noisy for you?」

name: Azel
message: 「It is not unpleasant.」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, if it isn't Lord Synn and Lady Azel. Welcome to our shrine.」

name: Azel
message: 「...? Are you a priest as well as a student?」

name: Shio
message: 「Yes, though I am still a novice.」

name: Azel
message: 「The academy's church enshrines God, and a deity is worshipped at this shrine as well. Which one is the false idol?」

name: Shio
message: 「Both are genuine. Though faiths may be many, in the end they are all one and the same.」

name: Azel
message: 「Have you ever laid eyes upon the Lord's form?」

name: Shio
message: 「I have not.」

name: Azel
message: 「Then why assert it with such confidence? How could you possibly know without having seen it?」

name: Shio
message: 「Hmm... Lord Azel, is this earth upon which I stand round?」

name: Azel
message: 「It is round.」

name: Shio
message: 「And you have beheld that with your very own eyes?」

name: Azel
message: 「I have. I saw it in a photograph. Therefore, I have captured it with my own eyes.」

name: Shio
message: 「Then I am in the exact same position as you, Lord Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You guys are way over my head with this topic.」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, it is simplicity itself!」

name: Azel
message: 「What is so simple about it? If a god truly resides here, then how do you explain the current state of this world?」

name: Azel
message: 「If things continue as they are, ruin is certain. Is that the will of the god you serve?」

name: Shio
message: 「Insofar as the deity enshrined at our shrine is concerned, destruction is indeed possible.」

name: Azel
message: 「Fool. You are a priest, yet what nonsense are you spouting?」

name: Shio
message: 「The god worshiped by the Asukai is a life born from the condensed breath of nature; thus, the decline of nature's spirit reflects directly upon their very being.」

name: Shio
message: 「The state of the god merely mirrors the vitality of the world in this present moment.」

name: Azel
message: 「Absurd. Then why is this place so remarkably pure?」

name: Shio
message: 「Because the hearts of those who visit to worship--starting with the children playing in the shrine grounds--are clear and pure.」

name: Azel
message: 「Wrong. It is because breathing the clean air here naturally puts one's mind at ease.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, aren't you two basically saying the same thing?」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed.」

name: Azel
message: 「We are not.」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」

name: Azel
message: 「Granted, this place is not bad, but the trees are too overgrown and cast too much shadow. If everything were reduced to nothing and reborn, it would be far better.」

name: Shio
message: 「You speak almost as though a god were passing away from this world.」

name: Shio
message: 「Then, supposing you were to recreate the sacred grounds of Asukai... Hmm, what would you plant first for the shrine grove?」

name: Azel
message: 「I looked through a botanical encyclopedia at the library. I can understand the trees here. If it were me, I would plant oak, chinquapin, and konara oak. That will become a forest」

name: Shio
message: 「That is not enough」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel, no good」

name: Azel
message: 「What is?」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, Ryuusei Town gets hit directly by the sea breeze, right? Even more so since Asukai Shrine is on a hill, so it's basically taking the brunt of it」

name: Synn
message: 「Without trees like machilus, Japanese fig, or privet to act as a windbreak, the forest will wither away, I'm telling you」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed」

name: Azel
message: 「Is my way no good? Yet the priestess said it was simple」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan doesn't lie. It's just that you aren't a simple person, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. I understand」
R-Really?

name: Azel
message: 「I am glad I came here. I shall ponder in order to understand」

name: Shio
message: 「It was a fine visit」
True to her word, Azel heads down the main approach with a deeply pensive look on her face. The atmosphere makes it impossible to call out to her.
I'll ask her about the Holy Night Festival another day.

name: Shio
message: 「Lady Azel possesses quite a mysterious aura, does she not?」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't have the power to sense that. Though I can tell that both you and Azel are amazing」

name: Synn
message: 「You two were having a really difficult back-and-forth that I couldn't wrap my head around at all」

name: Shio
message: 「Truth be told, this humble one did not understand a single bit of it either」

name: Synn
message: 「S-S-S-Shio-chan?」

name: Shio
message: 「Everything I said during that exchange with Azel-dono was merely parroting my mother. Goodness, had she pressed me any further, I would have been at a loss for words」

name: Shio
message: 「However, the part about the trees that Lord Synn mentioned at the end... that much, I understood myself」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, anyone who lives in this town would know as much」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel is a transfer student. By Christmas, he'll be much more settled into Ryuusei Town」

name: Shio
message: 「In that case, I shall listen to even more stories from Mother in preparation for Hatsumode」
A few minutes after Azel, I leave the shrine as well.
Looking at the blue of the sky and the sea, a thought suddenly crosses my mind. I wonder if they look the same color to Azel's eyes too?
